purpose: Teach: 小笠原/手塚/工藤/テキサス/バスク/ヤクザ/弥生/ロッテ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが小笠原諸島のドキュメンタリーを観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was watching a documentary about the Ogasawara Islands.
lines.style: Gentle, warm observation. Soft opening. Speaking to the child at eye level. A small, easy smile in the voice — sharing something nice she noticed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと手塚治虫の鉄腕アトム読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read Astro Boy with Dad — the Tezuka Osamu one.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick tempo. Bouncing slightly on the words. Small boy proud of what he did with his father. Direct eye contact energy in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが工藤先生というお医者様のお知り合いなのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father happens to know Dr. Kudo — a doctor, actually.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing tone. Slight pause before the detail, like she's considering how to explain it. Warm but not gushing. Adult-to-child register, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとテキサスの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a picture book about Texas with Dad.
lines.style: Unrushed, genuine excitement. Clear articulation. The tone of a small boy sharing something interesting he learned. No performance, just delight in the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバスク料理を作って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is apparently going to make Basque food for us.
lines.style: Light, pleased tone. Slight lift in the middle — she's genuinely happy about this. Speaking to Sho but also a little to herself. Warm anticipation underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがヤクザに関わるなって厳しく仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was really strict with me — he said I should never get involved with yakuza.
lines.style: Serious undertone despite the childhood voice. Quiet, thoughtful delivery. The weight of what his father said sits in him. Not scared, but taking it seriously.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが弥生時代の博物館に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father says he's going to take you to the Yayoi Period Museum.
lines.style: Warm anticipation. Gentle, even pacing. Speaking as though sharing a small gift of information. The pleasure of knowing something nice is coming for her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとロッテのお菓子買ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I bought snacks from Lotte together.
lines.style: Contented, settled closing. Soft smile in the voice. A small boy satisfied with a simple, good memory. Warm and uncomplicated. Trailing gently to a close.
